The library's proof is literally the one-line application `tensor_smul_left _ _ _`. (The analogous linear-map statement `LinearMap.rTensor_smul` in Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/TensorProduct/Map.lean:461 concerns `LinearMap.rTensor`, a different function, so it is only the underlying reason, not the matching statement.)
